This '''settlement''' was founded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Muzara]] by [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers from the [[Brentaal League]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. The settlers operated as [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]], which brought them into conflict with the native [[Muza]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who had no concept of land ownership.<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref>
